trust_decision.summary: Whether an unauthenticated POST to /bots/<bot_uuid> really comes from Lark/Feishu is never decided: both Lark handle_unified_webhook implementations accept any JSON body (plaintext, or 'encrypt' decrypted with the configured key) and turn it into message, card-action, app_ticket and bot-added events with no signature or verification-token check.

landing_point.why: The current 'lark-omni' adapter's handle_unified_webhook is what a search for the Lark webhook entry finds first; it is the package named after the platform (manifest name lark-omni at src/langbot/pkg/platform/adapters/lark/manifest.yaml:5).
